instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read, list, set, supersede, retire or delete my resource pricing rules, with effective dates, resource, plan and client overrides, without changing purchased terms", and give it action.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:manage-usage-pricing and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Read, list, set, supersede, retire or delete my resource pricing rules, with effective dates, resource, plan and client overrides, without changing purchased terms

4. It reads and writes nothing itself. You read the usage-pricing-rule and usage-pricing-rule-version rows from your own store and hand them in (rows for a list, current for save, retire or delete, version_row for a read of one version, prior_receipt for a repeated request_key). It answers keep: the rule head, its new version row and the receipt row, which you write in one transaction while the head is still at the version you read (expected_version).
